stem: Researchers are investigating processes that happen during digestion. Which answer choice describes only a physical change during digestion?

options.label: F
options.text: Hydrochloric acid in the stomach breaks down proteins.

options.label: G
options.text: Chewing in the mouth breaks food into small pieces.

options.label: H
options.text: Enzymes in saliva start the digestion of starches before food is swallowed.

options.label: J
options.text: Bacteria in the intestines convert dietary fiber into fats.

visual_elements: 2019 - Q42; Some text with four multiple choice answers labeled F, G, H, J
